# Marek Duciuc

> AI enablement for e-commerce and logistics operations. Since 2026 on a contract as Integration Engineer, AI automation (software company, name not disclosed), building AI assistants for service desk tickets and Power Automate integrations. Former Head of Fulfilment Operations at Doocan.com (team of ~40, Oct 2025 – Apr 2026). 10+ years in backend development, search infrastructure (Elasticsearch/OpenSearch) and technical support (Elastic, Opster, Conrad Electronic, Trask). Based in Ostrava, Czechia (CET). Open to new full-time contracts in EMEA (remote/hybrid) and one-day AI workshops for operations teams. Languages: Czech (native), English (C1), Polish (A2, passive).

## Case studies

- [All case studies](https://marekduciuc.github.io/case-studies/): the complete list
- [AI in the daily operations of an e-commerce fulfilment centre](https://marekduciuc.github.io/case-studies/doocan.html): stock-tracking add-on in daily production use, OpenSearch event store with tens of thousands of events a day, supplier sourcing agent, ~10 colleagues trained, 99+% order fulfilment precision
- [Disciplined agentic development: from requirement to pull request with AI agents](https://marekduciuc.github.io/case-studies/tdd-flow.html): tdd-flow Claude Code plugin – 4 workflows, 8 specialist agents, test-first implementation, human approval gates, push gate with tests and secret scan, cost caps; builds multi-task features task by task against the acceptance criteria of an approved spec

- [An AI assistant for support tickets and integrations, safe by design](https://marekduciuc.github.io/case-studies/support-automation.html): two Claude Code plugins built on a contract with a software company (since 2026) – service desk ticket workspace with per-ticket memory and an allow-listed API gateway, Power Automate specialist with analysis, critic, review loop and dev-only deployment, three human checkpoints, read-only production, self-proposed improvements reviewed by a person (8 of 10 accepted)
- [Elasticsearch in production: fast, stable and trusted with a bank's logs](https://marekduciuc.github.io/case-studies/elasticsearch.html): Rally baseline, bulk indexing from 20 to ~1,800 ops/s, full reindex from 3 days to hours, search latency −20%; cluster consulting (mapping, sharding, sizing, hot-warm, ILM/SLM) with significant cost reductions; central log management for a Czech bank (GBs of logs a day, Beats/Logstash, Kibana dashboards, role mapping to Active Directory, one-to-one Kibana training); three years of production support at Elastic
- [From a paper manual to a Czech document: AI only where it is needed](https://marekduciuc.github.io/case-studies/manual-translator.html): tool built for an e-commerce shop (2026) – photos or scans of paper manuals in English or Polish to editable Czech DOCX/PDF; local noise removal, orientation, deskew, booklet splitting, page sorting, cropping, language detection and Tesseract OCR; Claude only reads and translates each page (image plus OCR text); pages in unselected languages never reach the AI; retries, per-page cache, output caps

## Projects

- [tdd-flow (marek-plugins)](https://github.com/marekduciuc/marek-plugins): Claude Code plugin – multi-agent development pipeline from spec to pull request with human approval gates
